method: Reviewed all 212 distinct local product assets on 14 labelled contact sheets.
Evaluated every one of the 981 catalogue SKUs against its official-page evidence.
Fetched all 425 distinct indexed Dragino product pages and inspected all 8,183 image references found in their HTML galleries and linked image elements.
Compared unresolved products against 5,518 distinct official Dragino image assets.
Classified 15 official PDF links for catalogue relevance; the only current exact catalogue match, RS485-LN, was already supported by its official product-page image.
notes: Shared family images were retained only where the official Dragino page or grouped product imagery supports the represented model family or option.
The 148 placeholders are intentional: no reliable official product image was identified after the full indexed-page and asset search.
No catalogue SKU, workbook value, product specification, compatibility claim, certification, application, or supplier price was changed.
